page.overview:
Who is Gurumi Borlumi?

Gurumi Borlumi is non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is an antagonist during the samurai quests.

Gurumi Borlumi is a merchant of Limsa Lominsa known for his obsession with Hingan and everything related with it's culture. He was secretly a serial murderer who had already killed three innocent persons with a katana, as he believed that a katana was really valuable when it was used to kill.

His murder spree caught the attention of Musosai, who requested the help of the Warrior of Light in solving the case. Their investigations soon lead them to Gurumi and they were able to get on his ship, where they fought his legion of ninjas and his personal bodyguard Ostyrgrein. Once defeated, Musosai doesn't hesitate and kills Gurumi for his crimes.

He is a Lalafell with his head shaved, only keeping his hair tied in a ponytail. He is dressed in a golden colored kimono.
